Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-research.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Acceptance retained; this audit did not run its proposed tests.

Remaining / next action: Define a typed causal-licensing basis distinguishing linguistic entailment from world-knowledge hypotheses under ADR 0005. Preserve conservative Hypothesized status until a particular claim has a license.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: maintenance. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Retained with its original acceptance scope; recheck against current code before implementation or closure. Not a prerequisite for the annotation-assisted preview.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Design a typed compiler-owned licensing basis for provider-proposed narrative relations, beginning with CausalProposal, so a future slice can distinguish linguistic entailment, world-knowledge inference, and hypothesis without assigning a default epistemic license. This follow-on must not widen the first compiler slice. It is required by the chief HOLD msg-01M17DC25ARFXZT9H728PTFRSD and exact-candidate review post-01M17D9MD4E59FKM99MA0NX2BP, which found CausalProposal carried only CausalRelation while materialization fabricated LinguisticallyEntailed. Current ADR 0005 truthfully uses Hypothesized as the conservative floor.
